name: linux-kernel-analysis
description: Source-grounded workflows for analyzing mainline Linux kernel code and publishing validated learning books.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze kernel source and publish learning books.
interface.longDescription: A family of source-grounded workflows for static analysis of mainline Linux kernel boundary contracts, object lifetimes, state and path selection, execution-context handoffs, concurrency, resource flow, failure recovery, and performance mechanisms, plus publication of validated Markdown and Typst learning books with PDF and ZIP deliverables.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this mainline Linux kernel subsystem from source.
Trace the source-defined execution-context handoffs in this mainline driver.
Derive the boundary contracts of this mainline kernel component.
Turn this source analysis into a validated Markdown and Typst kernel learning book.
